draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.93, the 189th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 12th of 15 at TE. He went 165th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing concerns: broad jump (16th percentile). College production: his final season (2024) ranked 3rd in receiving yards among the 15 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Chargers. 15 career games and 7 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 6 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: yards per target 9.6 (90th percentile), approximate value 6 (90th percentile), receiving yards 664 (89th percentile). Weak spots: drop rate 7.2% (18th percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 tight end who played: 664 receiving yards against a median of 158, above the norm.
